reports.FUND_ID: key: track identity for dedup across period files, kpi:tracks
reports.PARENT_COMPANY_ID: skip: identifier of the parent company; parent ownership is summarised by the managing body, which is what the page groups by
reports.PARENT_COMPANY_NAME: skip: 18 parent-company names that map onto the 9 managing bodies already charted; a second ownership axis would repeat the market-share view
reports.CONTROLLING_CORPORATION: skip: one controlling group per managing body (9↔9) — duplicates chart-managers
reports.REPORT_PERIOD: chart-assets, chart-yields, chart-rolling, chart-net, chart-exposure, chart-flows, kpi:assets
reports.INCEPTION_DATE: skip: track launch dates are administrative (tracks are re-registered on mergers), so counts by launch year would not mean new products
reports.ACTUARIAL_ADJUSTMENT: skip: empty for every track since 2017 (the period the page covers)
reports.YIELD_TRAILING_3_YRS: skip: cumulative 3-year yield — the page uses its annualised twin (AVG_ANNUAL_YIELD_TRAILING_3YRS), which is comparable across horizons
reports.YIELD_TRAILING_5_YRS: skip: cumulative 5-year yield — the page uses its annualised twin (AVG_ANNUAL_YIELD_TRAILING_5YRS)
reports.ALPHA: skip: alpha against an unpublished benchmark per track — not comparable across tracks without knowing each benchmark
reports.MANAGING_CORPORATION_LEGAL_ID: skip: company registration number of the managing body — an identifier, the page uses the name
reports.REPORTING_YEAR: skip: duplicates the year part of REPORT_PERIOD (older files only)
reports.CURRENT_DATE: skip: file export timestamp (newest file only), not a data value
reports._resource_name: key: deterministic tie-break when a track-month appears in two period files
